Roster and rank verification handled separately

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A bachelor’s-to-PhD route is explicitly available (90 graduate credits; 60 after an appropriate master’s). A
completed UChicago mathematics degree is compatible with this route. International applicants are supported
by the graduate application process. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select Mathematical Sciences PhD; invite three academic/professional recommenders able to assess graduate
study, upload all postsecondary transcripts, request English waiver by email, and request any application-fee
waiver before payment. Resolve conflicting deadlines with grad@wpi.edu and department. [s1] [s3] [s5]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No prior supervisor agreement is published as an application prerequisite. Contact department via
ma-questions@wpi.edu; closest direct fit is Jane Ivy Coons (applied algebraic geometry). William Martin
provides adjacent algebraic-combinatorics/representation-related interests. Confirm Fall 2027 supervision
capacity. [s4] [s9] [s10] [s12]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Invite recommenders through online application; required materials must arrive before review. Submitted
applications have a status-page checklist and completion email. Reviews commonly take six to eight weeks,
starting after the priority deadline for early applications. [s1] [s3]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Central timetable explicitly covers Fall 2027 but conflicts with mathematics-specific standing deadlines.
Mathematical Sciences says SOP not required even though generic graduate advice describes statements for
most programs. Current English page uses new TOEFL 4.5 while FAQ retains 84. Stipend agreement expires
August 14, 2027. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s7]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application; Funding consideration [Conflict]
Conflict: program-specific mathematics table says January 1 for full fall consideration, March 31 last date to
start a fall application, October 31 last date to start a spring application. Central explicit 2027-28 table instead
lists Fall 2027 priority January 14, latest August 6, start August 19. Use the earlier January 1 complete-file
target for funding until mathematics confirms. [s1] [s2]
Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Mathematics row recommends completing credentials within 30 days of application submission, but January 1
is the full-consideration target. No separate letter or test-score grace deadline is published. Central page says

applications advance for review only after all required materials arrive. Do not read the 30-day
recommendation as an extension of funding priority. [s1]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Conflict]
Current requirements page: TOEFL iBT 4.5, IELTS 6.5 (minimum band 6.5), or Duolingo 115 for most programs.
The separate FAQ still gives pre-2026 TOEFL 84; use the current scale and confirm program exceptions. Official
scores required unless waived; paper IELTS forms not accepted. [s1] [s5]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Request a waiver at grad@wpi.edu after two years/four semesters of full-time continuous postsecondary study
in an approved English-speaking country within the past five years; the US is included. Completed UChicago
undergraduate study fits, subject to approval. Degree completion is not a stated prerequisite to this two-year
route. [s1] [s5]
GRE General [Unresolved]
Mathematics row specifies the subject test but does not establish a separate General GRE requirement,
recommendation or prohibition. Confirm rather than applying another department’s GRE rule. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE Mathematics Subject Test is strongly recommended in the mathematics program-specific requirements
table. [s1]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three recommendation letters from people able to assess qualifications for graduate study. The one-letter
exception is for WPI BS/MS applicants and does not apply to this PhD application. [s1]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Graduate applicants are automatically considered for funding; no separate normal funding application is
required. No additional fellowship reference or essay prompt is published for Mathematical Sciences. [s2]
What sends the invitation; Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
Applicants invite recommenders electronically through the application. Public instructions do not establish
whether saving details immediately sends an invitation or whether application submission is required first. [s1]
[s3]

Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
After application submission, a status-page link permits checking that required materials have arrived. Once
complete, an email confirms the application is under review. [s1]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Public instructions do not specify whether submitted letters can be replaced, updated or reused across
programs/cycles. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
University agreement effective August 15, 2026 sets minimum salaried RA/TA stipend $42,450 for a
TWELVE-month appointment; shorter appointments are prorated. Thus this is not proof that math guarantees
$42,450 annually. Mathematical Sciences says all its PhD students are fully funded; precise appointment
length/tuition terms require the offer. Salaried RA/TA health premium is 100% subsidized. [s4] [s6] [s7] [s8]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Program reports roughly five entering PhD students per year and all students fully funded, but a guaranteed
number of funded years and summer appointments are not specified in the cited program page. The current
labor agreement expires August 14, 2027, immediately before Fall 2027 starts. [s4] [s7]
International eligibility [Unresolved]
No citizenship exclusion is stated in the all-PhD funding statement. Confirm international appointment
eligibility and any teaching-language certification in the offer; English admission waiver alone does not
establish a TA exemption. [s4] [s8]
Conditions and duties [Prior cycle]
2023-27 agreement prorates stipend for appointments under twelve months. Instructor of Record receives
$1,000 per course/term extra; Head TA $550. RA/TA individual health premiums are fully subsidized, and family
subsidy equals twice the individual premium. Fall 2027 replacement agreement/rates are not established. [s7]
[s8]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Graduate applicants are automatically considered for funding; no separate normal funding application is
required. No additional fellowship reference or essay prompt is published for Mathematical Sciences. [s2]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Central admissions considers applicants automatically for funding. Departmental RA/TA options are confirmed,

but named additional scholarships, international eligibility and extra essay requirements were not established.
[s2] [s4]
Application fee [Standing rule]
$70 graduate application fee in Mathematical Sciences table. [s1]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
To be considered for a graduate application-fee waiver, email grad@wpi.edu. Public FAQ does not publish a
deadline, guaranteed criteria, citizenship restriction or refund policy. Ask before payment. [s5]

sections.text:
1. Applied algebraic geometry
Jane Ivy Coons
Toric and polyhedral geometry, algebraic statistics, phylogenetic and graphical models. [s9] [s10] [s11]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · Geometry of rational quasi-independence models as toric fiber products
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
2. Adjacent algebraic combinatorics
William J. Martin
Association schemes, Bose-Mesner algebras, finite geometry, coding and quantum information; adjacent rather
than core arithmetic/complex algebraic geometry. [s9] [s12]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2024 · Quantum isomorphism of graphs from association schemes
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
University agreement effective August 15, 2026 sets minimum salaried RA/TA stipend $42,450 for a
TWELVE-month appointment; shorter appointments are prorated. Thus this is not proof that math guarantees
$42,450 annually. Mathematical Sciences says all its PhD students are fully funded; precise appointment
length/tuition terms require the offer. Salaried RA/TA health premium is 100% subsidized. [s4] [s6] [s7] [s8]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Program reports roughly five entering PhD students per year and all students fully funded, but a guaranteed
number of funded years and summer appointments are not specified in the cited program page. The current
labor agreement expires August 14, 2027, immediately before Fall 2027 starts. [s4] [s7]
International eligibility [Unresolved]

eligibility and any teaching-language certification in the offer; English admission waiver alone does not
